"General direction of Confederate line of battle, Sept. 16th 1862" and "(General direction of) Confederate line of battle, Sept. 17th 1862 (evening)" are hand-colored in red. Union troop positions are not indicated. Detailed map of the environs of Sharpsburg showing roads, the "Washington Co. R.R.," fences, houses, names of residents, vegetation, drainage, villages, the "Burnside Bridge," "Bloody Lane," "Dunker's Chapel," "National Cemetery," and relief by hachures. In this issue, the map is printed on a yellow background with the Potomac River colored green. Description derived from published bibliography. Scale 1:21,120. LC Civil War Maps (2nd ed.), 245.8 Available also through the Library of Congress web site as raster image.
